AberrantHypermorph.description: Summons an Aberrant Hypermorph in a free adjacent hex. The Aberrant Hypermorph can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn. Aberrant Hypermorph's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AberrantHypermorph.name: Aberrant Hypermorph

AdaptiveStrategy.description: Triggers Relentless March again for all adjacent Non-Character friendly units and makes them immediately take an action, dealing {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Damage per hit if they attack.
AdaptiveStrategy.name: Adaptive Strategy

AetherStride.description: Summons Z'Kar as a stationary unit in a 3 hex area on the battlefield. If he is summoned adjacent to a friendly Psyker, he immediately performs a normal attack against a target in range. When Z'Kar is defeated or leaves the battlefield via his Hunter of Souls battlefield ability, he returns as Machine of War. Z'Kar Stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
AetherStride.name: Aether Stride

AlphaWarrior.description: If the Winged Prime has not moved this turn, summons a Tyranid Warrior on a free hex within Synapse range. The Tyranid Warrior cannot move this turn, but can immediately perform a normal attack against an enemy in range. Tyranid Warrior stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AlphaWarrior.name: Alpha Warrior

AncestralFortune.description: Ûthar gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and +{[extraBlockChance]}% Block chance until the start of his next turn. If he is adjacent to an enemy unit, he immediately performs an attack, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma. After a combined total of {[nrOfAttacks]} attacks that Ûthar has Blocked or scored Crits in after using Ancestral Fortune, the ability can be used again.
AncestralFortune.name: Ancestral Fortune

ArmoriumCherub.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a target within range {[range]}. Using Armorium Cherub does not end Vindicta's turn.
ArmoriumCherub.name: Armorium Cherub

AttemptedPossession.description: Target an enemy within {[range]} hexes. The target and any Summons it has summoned become possessed and immediately perform a normal attack against the closest enemy unit, preferring unpossessed targets. Possessed units deal {[dmgPct]}% of their own Damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit. Possessed Summons will move before attacking.
AttemptedPossession.name: Attempted Possession

AugmentedAssault.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to an adjacent enemy unit and reduces its Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour for the rest of the battle. Using Augmented Assault does not end Hâvyr's turn.
AugmentedAssault.name: Augmented Assault

BasiliskBarrage.description: If Thaddeus Noble has not moved, unleashes a barrage of {[nrOfProjectiles]} shells on any target on the battlefield, each dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} randomly hit the target hex or surrounding hexes and the remaining 2 hit the hexes surrounding those. For each round that has ended, 1 more of the shells hits the target hex, starting with the shells hitting the outer hexes. The Suppressive Fire trait applies also to this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
BasiliskBarrage.name: Basilisk Barrage

BioMinefield.description: Targets an enemy on the battlefield. If there are {[nrOfSummons]} or more Spore Mines on the battlefield, all Spore Mines immediately take a turn, moving towards the target, if possible. Otherwise, summon {[nrOfSummons_2]} Spore Mines in free hexes adjacent to the target. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage with Floating Death. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
BioMinefield.name: Bio-Minefield

BlackRage.description: If Lucien has not moved, he is set to {[hpPct]}% Health. He then immediately charges a targeted enemy in movement range and performs a normal melee attack against it. For this attack and until the end of the battle, Lucien has +{[extraMovement]} Movement and deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage when charging. Additionally, Lucien can no longer be controlled for the rest of the battle, and moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of his turn instead.
BlackRage.name: Black Rage

BlightedLand.description: Friendly Mythic characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage while on a Contaminated hex.
BlightedLand.name: Blighted Land

BloodChalice.description: All adjacent friendly non-mechanical units are set to {[healthPct]}% Health. Until the start of their next turn, affected units gain +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with melee attacks and heal for {[hpToHeal]} Health if they perform a melee attack.
BloodChalice.name: Blood Chalice

BloodyFury.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage to an adjacent enemy. This attack scores +{[extraHit]} hit for each time Wrask was attacked in this battle, to a maximum of {[maxNrOfHits]} hits total. Any leftover hits are allocated to remaining adjacent enemies, prioritising kills.
BloodyFury.name: Bloody Fury

BrazierOfHolyFire.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and sets its hex on Fire. Deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage vs Daemons instead. ALL Daemons within {[range_2]} hexes of the target take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Extra Damage this round and the next. Immune Daemons only take +{[extraDmgPct_2]}% Extra Damage.
BrazierOfHolyFire.name: Brazier of Holy Fire

BringerOfDespair.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to a melee target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to another random enemy adjacent to Angrax. Any resulting Battle Fatigue is triggered twice.
BringerOfDespair.name: Bringer of Despair

CabalOfSorcerers.description: Friendly Mythic Psyker characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage if they are adjacent to Z'Kar or adjacent to another friendly Mythic Psyker character.
CabalOfSorcerers.name: Cabal of Sorcerers

CalibaniteGreatsword.description: Forcas can switch between two stances. Strike Stance: At the end of his turn, Forcas starts Overwatching, even if he attacked in his turn. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, he remains in Overwatch, retaining {[nrOfHits]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Sweep Stance: Forcas' normal attacks also deal {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each enemy adjacent to both Forcas and the initial target. This ability can be used once per turn; each use switches the active Stance and does not end Forcas' turn. Only the first use of this ability in each battle counts as using an active ability.
CalibaniteGreatsword.name: Calibanite Greatsword

Chronometron.description: All enemy units within range {[range]} are Suppressed for {[nrOfRounds]} round. Affected Summons are Stunned instead. All affected enemies take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from the next attack made by a unit against them, or +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage if the attacker is Mechanical.
Chronometron.name: Chronometron

CombatRestoratives.description: Heals himself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health. {[hpToHeal_2]} Health if Imperial.
CombatRestoratives.name: Combat Restoratives

ContemptuousDisregard.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage while on a hex with a hex effect.
ContemptuousDisregard.name: Contemptuous Disregard

CordClaw.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy. All of Exitor-Rho’s further attacks until the end of its next turn deal an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage.
CordClaw.name: Chordclaw

CrusadeOfWrath.description: All other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage and +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio in melee – regardless of Damage type – for this round and the next. High Marshal Helbrecht immediately performs a normal melee attack against a random adjacent enemy.
CrusadeOfWrath.name: Crusade Of Wrath

CrushingClaws.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and Taunts them for 1 round. Enemies adjacent to both the Tyrant Guard and the target take {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage and then get pushed back 1 hex. All affected units become Suppressed for 1 round.
CrushingClaws.name: Crushing Claws

CultDemagogue.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and places decoys on up to {[nrOfSummons]} random free hexes within {[range_2]} hexes around the target. Then summons Neophyte Hybrids on half of all the friendly decoys in that area and all Neophyte Hybrids in that area immediately take a turn. Neophyte Hybrid stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage {[summonArmor_2]} Armour
CultDemagogue.name: Cult Demagogue

DaemonicOrdnance.description: Sets a target hex and the two hexes behind it on Fire. If one of these hexes is already on fire, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to enemies on it. Can deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. The Forgefiend's Crit Chance for both its abilities is increased by {[extraCritChance]}% for each time Daemonic Ordnance is used during a battle, but after the Forgefiend causes {[nrOfHits_2]} or more critical hits during its turn, it cannot cause any critical hits anymore for the remainder of the battle. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
DaemonicOrdnance.name: Daemonic Ordnance

DaemonicPatrons.description: Taunts an adjacent enemy, and Hascule gets watched until the end of his next turn. While being watched, Hascule deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for each adjacent Taunted enemy. If he defeats an adjacent Taunted enemy while being watched, he can use this ability again. If he does not, he loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health.
DaemonicPatrons.name: Daemonic Patrons

DakkaDakkaDakka.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds +{[extraHits]} hits for each time Snappawrecka was repaired this battle, but cannot exceed {[maxNrOfHits]} hits in total. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to random enemies within {[range_2]} hexes. Snappawrecka also loses {[healthPct]}% of his maximum Health.
DakkaDakkaDakka.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!

DarkTalonStrike.description: Azrael calls in a Ravenwing Dark Talon to deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to a target enemy within {[range]} hexes and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Bolter Damage to all enemies in an uninterrupted straight line originating from the initial target. All enemies hit are Suppressed. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DarkTalonStrike.name: Dark Talon Strike

DeathFromAbove.description: Summons 1 Inceptor for each round that has started. The Inceptors land adjacent to the target, whom they attack immediately. Note: if not enough hexes around the target are free, fewer Inceptors will be summoned. Inceptor stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
DeathFromAbove.name: Death From Above

DeathOnTheWind.description: Targets an enemy unit that was already attacked this turn. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} HeavyRound to all enemies on a straight line {[nrOfTiles]} hexes long, starting on the hex of the targeted enemy. Affected enemies take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from the next attack by a friendly Dark Angel this turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DeathOnTheWind.name: Death on the Wind

DefendTheDivineWork.description: Repairs himself and all friendly adjacent units {[hpToRepair]} Health.
DefendTheDivineWork.name: Defend The Divine Work

DevastatingRefrain.description: Marks a hex on the battlefield and 3 additional hexes adjacent to it but not to each other. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemies on marked hexes. Each enemy unit hit has a {[chance]}% chance to increase the Crit Chance and Crit Damage of friendly units with Act of Faith as if a friendly Imperial unit had killed an enemy unit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DevastatingRefrain.name: Devastating Refrain

DoctrinaImperatives.description: Tan Gi’da switches between two Imperatives that affect him and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units: Protector Imperative: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Conqueror Imperative: Affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against units with reduced Armour. This ability can be used once per turn instead of once per battle; each use switches the active Imperative. Tan Gi’da can attack after using this ability. Only the first use of this ability each battle counts as using an active ability.
DoctrinaImperatives.name: Doctrina Imperatives

DoomSiren.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy and up to {[nrOfUnits]} other random enemies adjacent to the target. For the rest of the battle, Adamatar's normal attacks score an additional hit for each enemy Overkilled by Doom Siren.
DoomSiren.name: Doom Siren

Doombolt.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage, evenly distributing the hits between all enemies within {[range]} hexes. Adds +1 hit for each hex on the battlefield that is currently on Fire. Cannot exceed 9 hits. When Ahriman defeats an enemy with his normal ranged attack and Doombolt has already been used, then Doombolt can be used again in this battle.
Doombolt.name: Doombolt

Drachnyen.description: Abaddon is set to {[hp]} Health and immediately performs a normal melee attack against an adjacent enemy unit. After this attack and for the rest of the battle, after performing a normal melee attack, Abaddon performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy unit, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. Abaddon cannot be set to higher Health than his maximum Health.
Drachnyen.name: Drach’nyen

DutyEternal.description: Summons Galatian as a stationary unit in a 3 hex area on the battlefield. After using this ability, Galatian can no longer be used as a Machine of War for the rest of the battle. Galatian stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
DutyEternal.name: Duty Eternal

EarlyWarningOverride.description: Summons 2 Shield Drones into free adjacent hexes. Newly summoned Shield Drones can immediately attack an enemy in melee, but cannot move this turn. Re'vas also starts Overwatching until the start of her next turn, dealing +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, she remains in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Shield Drones' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
EarlyWarningOverride.name: Early Warning Override

ElectrochaffBackups.description: Enemy units that have a Markerlight or have been damaged by a ranged attack deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage to Mythic characters for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
ElectrochaffBackups.name: Electrochaff Backups

EmpyricAmbush.description: Lhykhis moves adjacent to an enemy unit on the battlefield that has a free adjacent hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to it. Until the end of this turn, attacks against the target of Empyric Ambush made by other friendly characters that are Aeldari or traversed {[movement]} or more hexes this turn have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. When Lhykhis defeats an enemy with a normal melee attack, and Empyric Ambush has already been used, then Empyric Ambush can be used again in this battle. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
EmpyricAmbush.name: Empyric Ambush

EntropyCannons.description: Targets an enemy unit that has their Armour reduced or is within a friendly Contagion aura. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to the target. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
EntropyCannons.name: Entropy Cannons

EuphoricStrikes.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy. The next attack against that enemy this turn has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance. Using Euphoric Strikes does not end Laviscus' turn.
EuphoricStrikes.name: Euphoric Strikes

ExcruciatingFrequencies.description: Affects {[nrOfTiles]} hexes in a straight line in one of 6 directions. This attack has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance for each unit on affected hexes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to each enemy on affected hexes. Enemies hit are also Suppressed.
ExcruciatingFrequencies.name: Excruciating Frequencies

Executioner.description: An enemy target within range {[range]} takes {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage for each round that has started. If the target is eliminated, then an adjacent enemy unit also takes {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage for each round that has started.
Executioner.name: Executioner

ExemplarOfHate.description: Targets an enemy on the battlefield. For this round and the next, all friendly units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against that enemy with melee or Overwatch attacks. If that enemy is Chaos, it gets Suppressed and Asmodai or another friendly Dark Angel immediately performs a normal attack against the target, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of its own damage, to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit.
ExemplarOfHate.name: Exemplar of Hate

ExemplarOfTheKauyon.description: Commander Shadowsun disappears, then reappears on a target hex adjacent to an allied unit and immediately performs a normal attack against the closest enemy target. This attack deals an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Blast Damage. A stationary Command-Link Drone is summoned in the hex she previously occupied. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Command-Link Drone stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ExemplarOfTheKauyon.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon

ExemplarOfTheMontka.description: Until the end of this turn, Commander Farsight and all other friendly Characters with a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable and all their normal attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When attacking a Big Target, they deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage instead. Using Exemplar of the Mont'ka does not end Commander Farsight's turn.
ExemplarOfTheMontka.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka

FearOfTheUnseen.description: Can only be used if the Deathleaper has not moved this turn. All enemies within {[range]} hexes get Suppressed and trigger Battle Fatigue, if they have it. The Deathleaper vanishes and cannot be targeted or damaged for 1 round. In its next turn it can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is either within Synapse range, has Tall Grass or is not adjacent to an enemy and its attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
FearOfTheUnseen.name: Fear of the Unseen

FightingRetreat.description: Adjacent enemies gain a Markerlight. They also have {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits, to a minimum of one, and deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage for one round. Until the end of this turn, Darkstrider and adjacent allied units with the Ranged Specialist trait gain the effect of the trait even if they started their turn adjacent to an enemy unit. Using Fighting Retreat does not end Darkstrider's turn if he is adjacent to an enemy, and he can move again if already moved in this turn.
FightingRetreat.name: Fighting Retreat

FireAndReposition.description: May move as normal and attack. After attacking, she may make one more normal movement. In the following enemy turn, she takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from ranged attacks. Can only be used if Calandis has a target in range.
FireAndReposition.name: Fire And Reposition

FlailSwing.description: Performs a melee attack dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and triggering Haze of Corruption if the target is defeated. Any unit defeated by this attack or its add-on attacks from Haze of Corruption is always overkilled.
FlailSwing.name: Flail Swing

Foehammer.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an enemy within range {[range]} and the target is Stunned until the beginning of Arjac's next turn. For each Character that has been defeated in this battle, this ability deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
Foehammer.name: Foehammer

ForwardSpotter.description: Summons a Cadian Guardsman in a hex adjacent to the targeted friendly unit. The Cadian Guardsman immediately takes a turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cadian Guardsman stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ForwardSpotter.name: Forward Spotter

FoulInfusion.description: Pestillian and all friendly Chaos units within his Contagion aura deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Toxic Damage with their normal melee attacks for this round and the next. Pestillian then immediately performs a normal melee attack against a random adjacent enemy.
FoulInfusion.name: Foul Infusion

FragBomb.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an adjacent target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to ALL units adjacent to the target hex, except Kut Skoden himself.
FragBomb.name: Frag Bomb

FragstormGrenadeLauncher.description: Deals up to {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any leftover hits are allocated to enemy units within {[range]} hexes, prioritising kills.
FragstormGrenadeLauncher.name: Fragstorm Grenade Launcher

FrenziedFiring.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target enemy in range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to it. Scores an additional hit to the target for each free hex adjacent to it, up to a maximum of {[maxNrOfHits]} hits. Additional hits from Fleshmetal Guns are scored against each enemy attacked.
FrenziedFiring.name: Frenzied Firing

GauntletsOfUltramar.description: Deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Scores an additional hit against surrounding enemies.
GauntletsOfUltramar.name: Gauntlets of Ultramar

GetEmRuntz.description: Summons 1 Grot in each adjacent hex that also has an enemy unit adjacent to it. Newly spawned Grots can immediately attack an enemy in melee, but cannot move this turn. Enemy units attacked by a Grot this way are Taunted for 1 round. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
GetEmRuntz.name: Get ’Em Runtz

GrapnelLauncher.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to it. If Tjark is not already adjacent to the target, it is then pulled 1 hex towards Tjark if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. Tjark then moves to occupy the hex the target originally occupied if it's free, or a free adjacent hex if it is not. If there are no free hexes, then Tjark does not move.
GrapnelLauncher.name: Grapnel Launcher

GravitonRifle.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical to an enemy in range {[range]} and Stuns it for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This attack has +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio against MK X Gravis, Terminator Armour or Mechanical units.
GravitonRifle.name: Graviton Rifle

GreatFrostAxe.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and covers the hex the enemy stands on and all hexes adjacent to it in Ice. The Crit Damage bonus of the Ice is already applied for this attack.
GreatFrostAxe.name: Great Frost Axe

GrotTank.description: Calls in a Grot Tank in an adjacent free hex. The Grot Tank cannot move in its first turn, but can immediately attack an enemy in range. Grot Tank’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health +{[extraHp]} for each round that has started {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
GrotTank.name: Grot Tank

GuardianConstruct.description: Friendly Mythic characters that are affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
GuardianConstruct.name: Guardian Construct

HadesAutocannons.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a targeted enemy summon and all other enemy summons within 2 hexes of the target. Can deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
HadesAutocannons.name: Hades Autocannons

Hailstrike.description: Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For {[nrOfRounds]} round, it has +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with ranged attacks and attacks while Overwatching. When the affected unit targets an enemy with one of these attacks, the Storm Speeder attacks the same target, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Hailstrike.name: Hailstrike

HammerOfWrath.description: If Mataneo has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn, charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage to all enemies adjacent to it. If Mataneo is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, doubles the damage dealt by this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HammerOfWrath.name: Hammer of Wrath

HarbingerOfDestruction.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to up to {[nrOfUnits]} enemies within {[range]} hexes.
HarbingerOfDestruction.name: Harbinger of Destruction

HarvesterOfSouls.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target within range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to the target that are also within range {[range]} of Maugan Ra. These attacks score an additional hit if Maugan Ra has not moved this turn.
HarvesterOfSouls.name: Harvester Of Souls

HeavyRailRifle.description: Targets an enemy and fires the Heavy Rail Rifle at the start of Tson'ji's next turn. If targeting a unit, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. This damage is reduced by {[dmgPctReduction]}% for each hex the target has traversed during its last turn, to a minimum of 0 damage. Any damage dealt to Vehicles and Big Targets is increased by {[extraDmgPct]}% each. If targeting Machines of War, increases the cooldown of the target's secondary ability by {[cooldownIncrease]} round and has a {[chance]}% chance to also increase the cooldown of the primary ability by {[cooldownIncrease_2]} round. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HeavyRailRifle.name: Heavy Rail Rifle

HeavyWarpFlamer.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds +1 hit for each attack with Psychic Damage that friendly units have performed this turn. Cannot exceed {[maxNrOfHits]} hits. If this attack defeats the target, any leftover hits are scored against enemies adjacent to the target and within range {[range]}, prioritising kills.
HeavyWarpFlamer.name: Heavy Warpflamer

HellfyreMissileRack.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target enemy unit within range {[range]} and an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to each enemy unit on the map that was dealt Psychic Damage this turn, which can include the initial target again. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HellfyreMissileRack.name: Hellfyre Missile Rack

HeraldOfTheApocalypse.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy directly behind the target. Affected enemies receive +{[extraDmg]} Damage from the next attack made by a unit against them. Also triggers Battle Fatigue for all enemy units within {[range]} hexes of the original target.
HeraldOfTheApocalypse.name: Herald of the Apocalypse

HeroicFusillade.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free surrounding hex within movement range {[range]} of Judh or is already on a hex surrounding Judh. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to the target and all other enemies surrounding it. Crits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each free hex surrounding the targeted enemy. When Judh is resurrected and Heroic Fusillade has already been used, then it can be used again in this battle.
HeroicFusillade.name: Heroic Fusillade

HolyDuel.description: Brother Jaeger Taunts an adjacent enemy unit and immediately performs a normal attack against it. Brother Jaeger deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from the target while it’s Taunted by him. Brother Jaeger is also Taunted by the target and the taunt does not expire with rounds passed.
HolyDuel.name: Holy Duel

HyperCorrosiveAcid.description: Enemies that are damaged by a friendly Spore Mine take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from attacks by Mythic characters for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
HyperCorrosiveAcid.name: Hyper Corrosive Acid

Incursion.description: Summons a Bloodletter adjacent to an enemy target within range {[range]}. The Bloodletter immediately attacks the target. Keeps summoning Bloodletters up to a max of {[maxSummons]}, as long as the target has not been defeated, is in range and has a free hex adjacent to it. Bloodletter’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Incursion.name: Daemonic Incursion

InfernalCannon.description: Targets a hex on the battlefield. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies that are on Fire hexes or have taken Psychic Damage this turn. Then adds Fire to the targeted hex. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
InfernalCannon.name: Infernal Cannon

InspiredToGreatness.description: Enables a friendly unit in an adjacent hex to use their active ability again in this battle and heals or repairs it for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For this second use, the ability is at the lowest of its own level and that of Inspired to Greatness. If that unit has not used their active ability yet, then {[hpToHeal_2]} Health is restored instead.
InspiredToGreatness.name: Inspired to Greatness

IronkinSteeljack.description: Summons an Ironkin Steeljack in a free adjacent hex. The Ironkin Steeljack can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn. Ironkin Steeljack stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
IronkinSteeljack.name: Ironkin Steeljack

ItItches.description: Suppresses and pushes an adjacent enemy unit and all enemy units adjacent to both the target and the Parasite of Mortrex one hex backwards. Enemy steppables on affected hexes are destroyed. Then summons a Ripper Swarm in each hex vacated by this ability. The Ripper Swarms can immediately attack. The Parasite of Mortrex may move again after activating this ability. Ripper Swarm stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ItItches.name: It Itches!

JakhalStimms.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy and all other enemies adjacent to both Macer and the target. Then Macer loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health. Using Jakhal Stimms does not end Macer's turn.
JakhalStimms.name: Jakhal Stimms

KillMaimBurn.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy. Then performs a second attack targeting an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Eviscerating Damage. Then performs a third attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits_3]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Plasma Damage. All attacks prioritise the same target until it is killed and then prioritise kills.
KillMaimBurn.name: Kill! Maim! Burn!

LashOfTorment.description: Deals{[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]}. If the target is not already adjacent to Lucius, it is then pulled 1 hex towards him if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. If the target is adjacent to Lucius after the attack, it is also Taunted by him for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds.
LashOfTorment.name: Lash of Torment

LeadingTheCharge.description: If Dreir has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn and charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to it. Then, summons up to {[nrOfSummons]} Death Riders in free adjacent hexes that can immediately attack enemies in range. All attacks triggered by this ability have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle. Death Rider stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
LeadingTheCharge.name: Leading the Charge

LightOfSanguinius.description: If Dante has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn, then charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage to it. The target and enemy units surrounding it deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This effect is doubled if they attack friendly units that are at or below {[healthPct]}% Health.
LightOfSanguinius.name: Light of Sanguinius

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description: Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage to first target, {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage to the second, and {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Loki_SwoopingHawk.name: Swooping Hawk

MacroPlasmaIncinerator.description: Marks a target hex and the two hexes behind it for 1 round. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to all enemies in the marked area the first time an enemy unit ends their movement in it. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MacroPlasmaIncinerator.name: Macro Plasma Incinerator

MalleusRocketLauncher.description: Marks a hex on the battlefield. At the beginning of the Field Ordnance Battery's next turn, it unleashes a barrage of missiles. {[nrOfProjectiles]} missiles impact on the marked hex and {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} missiles impact in hexes adjacent to the target with a maximum of {[nrOfProjectiles_3]} impacts per unit. Each impact deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage and all units hit get Suppressed. Enemies hit within {[range]} hexes of a friendly Astra Militarum unit take +{[extraDmg]} damage from each hit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MalleusRocketLauncher.name: Malleus Rocket Barrage

MartialInspiration.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent enemy. This attack and attacks from Legacy of Combat this turn deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage for each turn in which Kariyan performed an attack this battle. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.
MartialInspiration.name: Martial Inspiration

MassDriverAccelerator.description: Can only be used if Kîmm has not moved. She and all friendly adjacent units have +{[extraMovement]} Movement until the end of this turn. Kîmm then charges a targeted enemy unit within movement range, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage to all enemies adjacent to the target.
MassDriverAccelerator.name: Mass Driver Accelerator

MasterOfTheTutelaries.description: Summon a Pink Horror on a free hex adjacent to Abraxas. Until the end of this turn, whenever an enemy unit is dealt Psychic Damage, summon a Screamer of Tzeentch on a free hex adjacent to Abraxas, preferring hexes adjacent to enemy units. Newly summoned units can immediately attack an enemy in range but cannot move. Pink Horror stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage Screamer of Tzeentch stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage
MasterOfTheTutelaries.name: Malefic Maelstrom

MastersOfManoeuvre.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks until the start of their next turn if they have traversed {[tilesTraversed]} or more hexes during their turn or end their turn next to a friendly Mythic Dark Angel.
MastersOfManoeuvre.name: Masters of Manoeuvre

MightFromBelow.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an adjacent enemy, then summons a Purestrain Genestealer on each decoy adjacent to the Patermine. The Purestrain Genestealers can immediately attack in melee, but cannot move this turn. Purestrain Genestealer stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MightFromBelow.name: Might From Below

MindControl.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes that is adjacent to one or more friendly units. For this round and the next, that enemy unit deals -{[dmgReduction]} Damage, takes +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage, and becomes Taunted by the adjacent unit with the highest current Health.
MindControl.name: Mind Control

MomentShackle.description: Trajann heals himself for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For {[nrOfRounds]} round, Trajann has +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and blocks an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage. During that round, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to each enemy unit that moves from a hex adjacent to him.
MomentShackle.name: Moment Shackle

MoreGitzOverEre.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Squig or adjacent to two or more friendly Mythic characters take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from normal melee attacks by Mythic characters.
MoreGitzOverEre.name: More Gitz Over 'Ere!

MortisRound.description: Deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a single target within range 3, which is then pushed back 1 hex. The Heavy Weapon trait applies double to this ability.
MortisRound.name: Mortis Round

MultiThreatEliminator.description: Deals 6x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage to an enemy within range {[range]}. Any leftover hits are allocated to another enemy adjacent to the target and in range {[range]}. Each enemy killed adds +{[extraHit]} hit and the ability keeps targeting new enemies until there are no more enemies or hits left.
MultiThreatEliminator.name: Multi-Threat Eliminator

MurderousSwing.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to all adjacent enemies. If this attack only hits one enemy, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
MurderousSwing.name: Murderous Swing

NanoscarabRepairProtocols.description: Targets a friendly mechanical unit that is not affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols. It is now affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols for the rest of the battle. The target immediately gains {[hp]} Health and its maximum Health increases by the same amount. When the affected unit regains Health, the amount it regains is increased by {[hpToRepair]} Health.
NanoscarabRepairProtocols.name: Nanoscarab Repair Protocols

OnMyPosition.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Cadian Guardsman or a friendly Mythic character take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks by mythic characters.
OnMyPosition.name: On my Position!

OverwhelmingWrath.description: Until the beginning of his next turn Azkor Taunts all adjacent enemies and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to all adjacent enemies at the beginning of Azkor's next turn.
OverwhelmingWrath.name: Overwhelming Wrath

PlagueWind.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlagueWind.name: Plague Wind

PlagueburstMortar.description: Targets a hex on the battlefield. All enemies on that hex or adjacent hexes that also either have their Armour reduced or are within a friendly Contagion aura take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage and become Suppressed for 1 round. Then adds Contamination to the target hex and random hexes adjacent to it, up to a total of {[nrOfTiles]} hexes. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlagueburstMortar.name: Plagueburst Mortar

PlasmaCannon.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to an enemy within range {[range]} and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} round. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
PlasmaCannon.name: Plasma Cannon

Poxwalkers.description: Summons Poxwalkers in {[chance]}-{[chance_2]}% of free hexes (rounded up) within Corrodius' Contagion aura. Newly summoned Poxwalkers immediately attack in melee, but cannot move this turn. Poxwalker’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Poxwalkers.name: Poxwalkers

PsychicMaelstrom.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. {[chance]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_2]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_3]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_4]}% chance to score another hit. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PsychicMaelstrom.name: Psychic Maelstrom

RadBombardment.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all units in a straight line in one of 6 directions and adds Contamination to all hexes in the line. All units hit are Suppressed for 1 round. The length of the line starts at 2 hexes and increases by 1 hex for each round that has passed and by 1 hex each time a friendly Mechanic restores Health of a unit. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
RadBombardment.name: Rad-Bombardment

ReanimationBeam.description: All friendly units that are affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols are repaired for {[hpToRepair]} Health. Affected Summons immediately take an action, using {[dmgPct]}% of their own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage when attacking. Until the start of the Reanimator's next turn, the first time a friendly unit affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols would be defeated, it is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
ReanimationBeam.name: Reanimation Beam

ResurrectionOrb.description: Resurrects a random friendly Mechanical character in a free adjacent hex and additionally summons Necron Warriors in free adjacent hexes. Summons one Necron Warrior for each round that has passed and for each friendly Mechanical unit that was defeated in this battle, up to a maximum of {[maxSummons]} Necron Warriors. Units are resurrected and summoned with {[hpPct]}% Health. Necron Warrior’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ResurrectionOrb.name: Resurrection Orb

RevitalizingMalignancy.description: Heals himself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health, and an additional +{[hpToHeal_2]} Health to Chaos units. Imperial units do not receive any healing.
RevitalizingMalignancy.name: Revitalising Malignancy

RitesOfMorkai.description: Baldr and all surrounding friendly non-mechanical units become Inspired for {[nrOfRounds]} round or until they are revived. The first time each inspired unit would be defeated, it is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Inspired units with Final Vengeance deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with all attacks. After using this ability, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack against an adjacent enemy.
RitesOfMorkai.name: Rites of Morkai

RitesOfRestoration.description: Heals herself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health. Resurrects {[nrOfHeroes]} random friendly Imperial Character and up to {[nrOfSummons]} random friendly Imperial Summons that have been defeated in this battle. Resurrected units appear in free adjacent hexes with {[hp]} Health and are unable to act on this turn. Only affects non-Mechanical units.
RitesOfRestoration.name: Rites of Restoration

SanctorumMissile.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all hexes adjacent to the target – with the exception of Morvenn Vahl's own hex, were she adjacent to the target.
SanctorumMissile.name: Sanctorum Missile

SavageEchoes.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to an adjacent enemy unit. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each free hex adjacent to Cezare. If Cezare is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, he also regenerates {[hp]} Health after using this ability.
SavageEchoes.name: Savage Echoes

ScarabHive.description: Summons 2 Scarab Swarms next to the target, whom they immediately attack using the Damage type Piercing. In any subsequent attack they use their normal damage type. Scarab Swarm’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ScarabHive.name: Scarab Hive

SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.description: A target enemy unit within {[range]} receives a Markerlight until the end of Sho'syl's next turn. At the beginning of Sho'syl's next turn, if he is still in play, the target is hit by a Seeker Missile dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.name: Seeker Missile Frequency Lock

SendInTheNextWave.description: Select a target within 2 hexes. Summon {[nrOfSummons]} Cadian Guardsmen plus one for each defeated friendly unit, who immediately appear and fire upon a target from random free hexes within range 2 of the target. The maximum number of Cadian Guardsmen this can summon is {[maxSummons]}. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SendInTheNextWave.name: Send In The Next Wave

SentinelDirectives.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} and Suppresses it for 1 round. Cannot be used if there is an enemy adjacent to Sy-Gex. Using Sentinel Directives does not end Sy-Gex's turn and he can still enter Overwatch this turn, unless he performs a normal attack.
SentinelDirectives.name: Sentinel Directives

ShieldOfFaith.description: When a friendly Mythic character Crits or attacks an enemy that is on a hex with Fire, it gains a Shield until the start of its next turn, unless it already has a shield. The shield's Health is {[shieldPct]}% of the affected character's maximum Health.
ShieldOfFaith.name: Shield of Faith

SilentDeath.description: Jain Zar throws the Silent Death at an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to it and up to {[nrOfTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to each other, before returning to Jain Zar’s hands.
SilentDeath.name: Silent Death

SkyStrike.description: If Celestine has not moved, she targets an enemy unit on the battlefield that has a free adjacent hex, then moves adjacent to it and attacks it. The attack deals the same damage as her normal attack plus an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
SkyStrike.name: Sky Strike

SorcerousFacade.description: Target a friendly Psyker. Until the beginning of Yazaghor's next turn both he and the target deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage with their normal attacks. Yazaghor performs a normal attack against the closest enemy unit, and then switches positions with the targeted Psyker. Note: this ability can only be used if Yazaghor has an enemy in range.
SorcerousFacade.name: Sorcerous Facade

SpiritLeech.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. If the target is Suppressed, deals an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage, otherwise Suppresses it. The Neurothrope heals itself and friendly Tyranids adjacent to it for Health equal to {[hpToHealPct]}% of the total damage dealt with this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SpiritLeech.name: Spirit Leech

SporeMineLauncher.description: Summons a Spore Mine onto a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage damage with Floating Death.
SporeMineLauncher.name: Spore Mine Launcher

SquigLaunchas.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit that has at least {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Ork or {[nrOfUnits_2]} friendly units adjacent to it. Then, if the target has {[nrOfUnits_3]} friendly Orks or {[nrOfUnits_4]} friendly units adjacent to it, summons a Large Squig on a random free hex adjacent to the target. Large Squig stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SquigLaunchas.name: Squig Launchas

SquigMine.description: Marks a free hex on the battlefield and additionally {[nrOfTiles]} random free hexes within range {[range]} of the target hex. Until the start of the Rukkatrukk's next turn, the first time a marked hex is occupied by an enemy, that enemy takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage, and the mark is removed. When a friendly unit occupies an affected hex, it does not take damage, and the mark is removed. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SquigMine.name: Squig Mine

SternguardFocus.description: Ramus performs a normal attack, using {[dmgPct]}% of his own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. If Ramus uses this ability while adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel, then it can be used again in his next turn without cooldown. Using Fire Discipline does not end Ramus' turn and he can still enter Overwatch at the end of his turn, unless he performs another normal attack.
SternguardFocus.name: Fire Discipline

StormOfWrath.description: Deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a unit within 2 hexes and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} adjacent units. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
StormOfWrath.name: Storm Of Wrath

Stormcaller.description: Target an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. The target's hex and all adjacent hexes get covered in Ice. All enemies on hexes covered in Ice take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage. Flying enemies damaged this way get Stunned for 1 round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Stormcaller.name: Stormcaller

StrikeFromTheShadows.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter to an enemy within range {[range]}. Until the end of Cyrus' next turn, all ranged attacks against the target ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour. After using this ability, Cyrus may move, even if he already moved this turn.
StrikeFromTheShadows.name: Strike from the Shadows

Supercharge.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Plasma Damage to up to two enemies in adjacent hexes behind the target, all with +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio. Until the beginning of Sarquael's next turn, any further hits that deal Plasma Damage against these units also have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
Supercharge.name: Supercharge

SupremeCommander.description: Summons up to {[nrOfSummons]}Cadian Guardsman in free adjacent hexes. All friendly Cadian Guardsmen within {[range]} hexes then immediately take a turn. If Colour Sergeant Kell is in play, summons an additional Cadian Guardsman and activation range is 3. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SupremeCommander.name: Supreme Commander

TacticalPrecision.description: Attacks a targeted adjacent enemy. If Titus has charged that enemy this turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. This attack is always a Crit and deals an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. If Titus did not charge the targeted enemy this turn, he instead deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Chain Damage to all adjacent enemies. When Titus gets revived or resurrected and Tactical Precision has already been used, then Tactical Precision can be used again in this battle.
TacticalPrecision.name: Tactical Precision

TalonsOfTheEmperor.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy unit. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time a friendly Character has used an active ability this battle. If the target is a Psyker or Atlacoya is adjacent to a friendly Adeptus Custodes, this attack deals Direct Damage instead.
TalonsOfTheEmperor.name: Talons Of The Emperor

TheQuickening.description: Targets a hex within movement range {[range]} that is neither occupied by an enemy nor by a friendly unit in Deep Strike. Mephiston moves onto that hex. If a friendly unit is on that hex, that unit moves to Mephiston's previous location. All Blood Angels moving this way perform a normal melee attack after they move, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of their own damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. Units moving this way do not trigger Overwatch or other movement related reactions.
TheQuickening.name: The Quickening

ThriceBlessedConflagration.description: Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, it deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with ranged attacks against enemies on Fire hexes. Affected Adepta Sororitas units deal additional damage with all attacks instead. The Exorcist then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies in the longest uninterrupted straight line originating from the targeted friendly unit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ThriceBlessedConflagration.name: Thrice-Blessed Conflagration

ThunderousAssault.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy and pushes it one hex backwards. The target is Stunned for 1 round. Sword Brother Godswyl then moves into the vacated hex if able. Enemies defeated by this attack are always overkilled.
ThunderousAssault.name: Thunderous Assault

TitanhammerSquad.description: Marks a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy unit. Lysander and all friendly Terminator Armour units within {[range]} hexes of Lysander are healed for {[hpToHeal]} Health and block an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage until the beginning of their next turn. If they have not moved in this turn, they can also move on or adjacent to the hex marked by this ability. Using Titanhammer Squad does not end Lysander's turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
TitanhammerSquad.name: Titanhammer Squad

TwinSmartMissileSystem.description: Targets an enemy unit on the battlefield, then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to each enemy unit that has a Markerlight. The target unit then receives a Markerlight for 2 rounds. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TwinSmartMissileSystem.name: Twin Smart Missile System

UnbreakableDuty.description: Ancient Thoread and all friendly units within {[range]} hexes receive -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage until the start of their next turn. If 2 or more friendly Imperial Characters are dead upon activation of this ability, Ancient Thoread gains {[extraHp]} extra Health and +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of the battle and immediately performs a normal attack against an adjacent enemy.
UnbreakableDuty.name: Unbreakable Duty

UnstoppableMomentumReworked.description: Charges in one of 6 directions and keeps moving in a straight line until he hits an obstacle or a Big Target. Any enemies hit by the charge take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage, increased by {[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex traversed from the starting hex to the enemy. Affected enemies get pushed and Suppressed for 1 round. A Big Target is Stunned for 1 round instead. Friendly units are also displaced, but take no damage or negative effects. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
UnstoppableMomentumReworked.name: Unstoppable Momentum

VexillaMagnifica.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy target and an additional adjacent enemy unit. Both enemies are Stunned for 1 round, and Aesoth receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.
VexillaMagnifica.name: Vexilla Magnifica

VigilanceEternal.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} of Tyrith or is already on a hex adjacent to Tyrith. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the targeted unit. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. Using Vigilance Eternal does not end Tyrith's turn.
VigilanceEternal.name: Vigilance Eternal

Waaagh.description: If Boss Gulgortz has not moved, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Ork Boyz in free adjacent hexes. Until the end of this turn, all friendly Orks and friendly units adjacent to Boss Gulgortz gain +{[extraMovement]} Movement and their normal melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and score an additional hit. Boss Gulgortz then charges a targeted enemy in movement range, performing a normal melee attack against it. All friendly Ork Boyz take a turn. Ork Boyz' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
Waaagh.name: Waaagh!

WarHowl.description: If Ragnar has not moved, he and all friendly Characters that don't have a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable until the end of this turn. Additionally, their normal melee attacks have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of this turn. Using War Howl does not end Ragnar's turn.
WarHowl.name: War Howl

WisdomOfTheAncients.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage if they are adjacent to Galatian or a friendly Mythic character.
WisdomOfTheAncients.name: Wisdom of the Ancients
